en.error.directory_required: Set the directory this provisioner keeps its workspaces in.
en.error.not_directory: {directory} is a file, not a directory. Set the directory to a folder on this worker.
en.error.already_mounted: {path} is already mounted for another workspace. Unmount that one first.
en.error.unknown_base: There is no workspace named {base} under {directory} to start from. Name an existing workspace, or leave the base empty.
en.error.missing_template: The template {template} is not a directory on this worker. Set the template to a directory, or leave it empty.
en.error.mount_failed: Preparing the directory {path} did not finish: {reason}. Try again.
en.error.remove_failed: Removing the directory {path} did not finish: {reason}. Try again.
en.error.check_failed: {directory} cannot be read on this worker, so it is not known whether {path} is there. Check that the disk is there.
en.error.list_failed: Listing the workspaces in {directory} did not finish: {reason}.
